SELECT target_id FROM training_scope_target WHERE training_id=#{trainingId} ORDER BY target_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training WHERE id=#{trainingId} AND created_by=#{ownerId}
SELECT * FROM training WHERE id=#{trainingId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_learning_session s JOIN training t ON (t.assessment_id=s.task_id OR t.id=s.training_id) WHERE t.id=#{trainingId} AND (s.training_id=t.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_audience r WHERE r.training_id=t.id AND r.candidate_name=s.candidate_name AND r.phone=s.phone))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_participant p JOIN training t ON t.assessment_id=p.task_id WHERE t.id=#{trainingId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_audience r WHERE r.training_id=t.id AND r.candidate_name=p.candidate_name AND r.phone=p.phone)

SELECT e.id,e.name,e.phone,e.department_id,d.name department_name FROM organization_employee e JOIN organization_department d ON d.id=e.department_id AND d.created_by=e.created_by WHERE e.created_by=#{ownerId} AND e.status='ACTIVE' AND d.status='ACTIVE'
SELECT id FROM organization_department WHERE created_by=#{ownerId} AND status='ACTIVE'
SELECT employee_id,assigned_at FROM training_audience WHERE training_id=#{trainingId}
